summary: Vision Marine Technologies filed a Form 6-K on July 17, 2026, reporting its unaudited financial results for the three and nine months ended May 31, 2026, and the completion of an at-the-market equity offering that sold 6,380,235 common shares for aggregate gross proceeds of $16,334,922 and net proceeds of $15,552,243. The filing includes a press release dated July 13, 2026, and July 14, 2026. This is a routine current report of foreign private issuer providing financial results and an offering update. No forced or abrupt management change, acquisition, divestiture, or other special situation is described. The category is Management Changes only if a forced/abrupt departure is the event itself, which is not present here.
